failureInjection.method: local-only temporary batch with an appended invalid SQL statement
failureInjection.reason: The public import handler has no failure-injection hook, and adding one would violate the requirement that temporary failure hooks are absent from committed code.

invalidInput.result: invalid regex or malformed subscription entry returns a non-success validation response before deletion; prior rows are not touched

rollbackGuarantee.basis: Cloudflare D1 batch executes the prepared statements transactionally and rolls back the complete batch on any statement failure.
rollbackGuarantee.subscriptionBatch: user-scoped delete followed by all user-scoped inserts
